description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Saudi Arabia working-day offset. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when financial-institution scope only. MHRSD business-sector leave, RTGS-specific intervals, government offices, private-employer rosters, Hajj-season branch exceptions and Umm al-Qura forecasts are not inferred.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts Saudi Arabia authority-scope working days in exact coverage.
Example user requests: Add or subtract Saudi Arabia working days around SAMA Eid Al-Fitr interval. | Add or subtract Saudi Arabia working days around Friday/Saturday weekly baseline. | Add or subtract Saudi Arabia working days around National Day Saturday substitution.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","working_days":0}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement only on status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/saudi-financial-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/saudi-financial-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_sa_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Exact SAMA financial-institution holiday intervals plus the annual National Day and Founding Day rules.

substitute_day_policy.description: SAMA states that National Day or Founding Day on Friday moves to Thursday and on Saturday moves to Sunday; the 2028 National Day substitute is included. Other employer or RTGS substitutions are not inferred.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Saudi Arabia Working Days
